_comment: Hand-curated return timetables, read by injury-returns.mjs. entries: { "<sleeper player_id>": { "kind": "team" | "report", "ret": "YYYY-MM-DD" (or "weeks": N | "season"), "source": "url or publisher", "checked": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "what was said" } }. kind "team" = the club's own timetable: it wins over everything and is not estimated. kind "report" (the default) = a media report: used only when ESPN has no return date and no timetable in its outlook; a dated report is not estimated, a weeks-only one is. flag = the audit's confidence (verified/uncertain). weeks_list = the exact fantasy weeks out (e.g. [6] or [6,7]; [] = not out). When present it wins over weeks/unit: contiguous from the current week it becomes a return date (the Sunday after the last listed week), with a gap the list itself (retWeeksList) is charged week by week; the entry is stale once every listed week is past and it was checked in an earlier week. Entries are rewritten by consensus.mjs (the 2026-10-14 audit merged with the Sleeper/ESPN projection and DraftKings props consensus); weeks there is the count of listed weeks.
